# ---------- Parse public.pem (DER) ----------
pem = open("public.pem").read()

def read_len(data, i):
    l = data[i]; i += 1
    if l & 0x80:
        num = l & 0x7f
        l = int.from_bytes(data[i:i+num], 'big'); i += num
    return l, i

def tlv(data, i):
    tag = data[i]; i += 1
    l, i = read_len(data, i)
    return tag, data[i:i+l], i+l

def find_two_ints(data):
    tag, val, _ = tlv(data, 0)
    assert tag == 0x30
    # try direct: INTEGER, INTEGER
    try:
        t1, v1, j = tlv(val, 0)
        t2, v2, _ = tlv(val, j)
        if t1 == 2 and t2 == 2:
            return int.from_bytes(v1,'big'), int.from_bytes(v2,'big')
    except Exception:
        pass
    # else skip first element (AlgorithmIdentifier), then BIT STRING
    t1, v1, j = tlv(val, 0)
    t2, v2, _ = tlv(val, j)
    if t2 == 3:  # BIT STRING
        content = v2[1:]  # strip unused-bits octet
        return find_two_ints(content)
    raise ValueError("cannot parse")
